responsibility: Declares the public Assertion module API, exporting the single assertion procedure used by bootstrapped GNU Modula-2 code to validate runtime conditions. It serves as the lightweight interface boundary for assertion-triggered halts, distinct from the broader exception and runtime-system headers.
same_name_distinction: This is the lightweight public declaration for Assertion_Assert. Unlike gcc/m2/pge-boot/GAssertion.cc, it has no failure-message emission or halt logic and exists only to expose the interface.
